_reclassification_note: RECLASSIFIED: This is NOT a comprehensive hospitalization indemnity plan. It is a FIXED-BENEFIT Critical Illness + Personal Accident plan (Benefit 1: Critical Illnesses/Medical Events/Surgical Procedures pays lump-sum SI on diagnosis then cover terminates; Benefit 2: Personal Accident). Standard hospitalization axes (room rent, ICU, co-pay, restoration, sub-limits, pre/post-hosp) DO NOT APPLY. Most axes null/Not specified by design. VERIFY before catalog inclusion — likely belongs in a separate CI/benefit category, not the indemnity Compare set.

room_rent.note: No room-rent concept; lump-sum on CI diagnosis

sub_limits.note: Lump-sum benefit; no disease capping in indemnity sense

ped_waiting.note: Any pre-existing disease/complication is a permanent exclusion under Benefit 1; VERIFY

specific_disease_waiting.note: VERIFY; CI plan uses 90-day initial waiting

maternity.note: Maternity permanent exclusion (Excl18); not relevant to CI plan

restoration.note: Cover terminates for insured after a CI claim

organ_donor.note: Major Organ Transplant is a covered CI event, not donor indemnity

notable_exclusions.display: Fixed-benefit CI plan: pre-existing disease permanently excluded; cover terminates after CI claim; congenital, self-harm, substance abuse

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident (Benefit 2), Second Opinion, Add-on benefits per schedule
